description: What a Texas county or city requires and where its rules live: official website, where its code is published and the edition, the documents we read (with dates), departments and contacts, whether it has zoning and an industrial pretreatment program, what we could not find, and when it was last researched. Pass a county or city name, or a location for the AHJs that govern it. Free shows the name, website and research status; Pro the full profile.

address.description: Texas street address, e.g. '1201 Main St, Houston, TX'. Use this or lat/lng.

lat.description: Latitude (WGS84). Use with lng instead of address.

lng.description: Longitude (WGS84). Use with lat instead of address.

name.description: County or city name, e.g. 'Bastrop County' or 'City of Taylor'.

name: ahj_profile
title: County or city permitting profile
